query: What reflexivity protocols and participatory validation processes will identify and mitigate deficit framings, ensure community co-interpretation, and integrate humanities-driven interpretive checks into dissemination?

response.query: What reflexivity protocols and participatory validation processes will identify and mitigate deficit framings, ensure community co-interpretation, and integrate humanities-driven interpretive checks into dissemination?
response.answer: Reflexivity protocols include self-reflection and peer review. Participatory validation involves community feedback. Humanities-driven checks ensure interpretive accuracy.
